results.evidence: The itinerary/timing say 6.5 hr car-to-car with the summit at +4 hr; descent_text says ~1.3 hr down vs 2.5-2.7 hr up (~4 hr total); partner_requirements says 3-3.5 hr round trips and a 1-1.5 hr approach.
